import json
from itertools import groupby

words = "helvetica daffodil beaujolais sky wakeful wayside viet squabble didactic abash quiz".split()

def letter_checks(claims, position):
    return all(
        word in words
        and word[position] == letter
        and ord(letter) - ord("a") + 1 == rank
        for word, letter, rank in claims
    )

def computed_groups(depths):
    key = lambda word: word[:depths.get(word[0], 1)]
    return [
        sorted(group)
        for _, group in groupby(sorted(words, key=key), key=key)
    ]

def claimed_groups(text):
    return [sorted(block.split("/")) for block in text.split()]

claims1 = [
    ("helvetica", "h", 8), ("daffodil", "d", 4),
    ("beaujolais", "b", 2), ("sky", "s", 19),
    ("wakeful", "w", 23), ("wayside", "w", 23),
    ("viet", "v", 22), ("squabble", "s", 19),
    ("didactic", "d", 4), ("abash", "a", 1),
    ("quiz", "q", 17),
]
checks = {1: letter_checks(claims1, 0)}
checks[1] = checks[1] and sorted(c[0] for c in claims1) == sorted(words)

snapshots = [
    (2, {}, "abash beaujolais daffodil/didactic helvetica quiz sky/squabble viet wakeful/wayside"),
    (4, {"d": 2}, "abash beaujolais daffodil didactic helvetica quiz sky/squabble viet wakeful/wayside"),
    (6, {"d": 2, "s": 2}, "abash beaujolais daffodil didactic helvetica quiz sky squabble viet wakeful/wayside"),
    (8, {"d": 2, "s": 2, "w": 2}, "abash beaujolais daffodil didactic helvetica quiz sky squabble viet wakeful/wayside"),
    (10, {"d": 2, "s": 2, "w": 3}, "abash beaujolais daffodil didactic helvetica quiz sky squabble viet wakeful wayside"),
]
for step, depths, text in snapshots:
    checks[step] = claimed_groups(text) == computed_groups(depths)

for step, position, claims in [
    (3, 1, [("daffodil", "a", 1), ("didactic", "i", 9)]),
    (5, 1, [("sky", "k", 11), ("squabble", "q", 17)]),
    (7, 1, [("wakeful", "a", 1), ("wayside", "a", 1)]),
    (9, 2, [("wakeful", "k", 11), ("wayside", "y", 25)]),
]:
    checks[step] = letter_checks(claims, position)

claimed_final = "abash beaujolais daffodil didactic helvetica quiz sky squabble viet wakeful wayside".split()
checks[11] = claimed_final == sorted(words)

first_error = next((step for step in range(1, 12) if not checks[step]), None)
print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": "No" if first_error is None else str(first_error),
    "evidence": {
        "checked_steps": len(checks),
        "failed_steps": [step for step in sorted(checks) if not checks[step]],
        "computed_order": sorted(words)
    }
}, separators=(",", ":")))
